shots.title: 第1集 镜1：负四层困梯互咬
shots.summary_zh: 幽绿应急灯下，右腿被铁架压断的赵坤满头冷汗，怒指对面灰头土脸的陆沉质问钢缆是不是他剪的。
shots.dialogue_zh: S2：陆沉！是不是你找人剪断了电梯钢缆！
shots.end_frame_anchor_zh: 赵坤咬牙怒视，陆沉靠在锈蚀铁壁上冷笑抹去额头血迹。
shots.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Gritty modern Chinese neo-noir thriller anime style, dark claustrophobic industrial lighting, emerald green emergency glow and harsh crimson shadows, tense medium two-shot inside a cramped wrecked industrial freight elevator lit by flickering emerald-green emergency light, rusty metal walls, fallen steel scaffolding beams pinning a man's leg. On the floor, a 42-year-old broad-jawed Chinese man (S2) with short graying buzz cut and a scar near his left eyebrow, wearing a rumpled dark brown wool coat over a sweat-stained white shirt, sweats heavily in pain and glares furiously at the rival across from him, growling in a gruff, hoarse, commanding older Chinese male voice (S2): <d>[Chinese] 陆沉！是不是你找人剪断了电梯钢缆！</d> Opposite him crouches a 36-year-old Chinese man (S1) with sharp eyes and messy dusty black hair, wearing a torn dark charcoal tailored suit with a loosened black tie, wiping dust and blood from his forehead with a furious glare.

overall_soundscape: Creaking damaged elevator cables overhead, buzzing flickering emergency light, pained heavy breathing echoing in tight steel box.

non_diegetic_music: Dark claustrophobic industrial synth pulse with tense low cello tremolos.

shots.title: 第1集 镜2：互相指责设局
shots.summary_zh: 陆沉暴怒反呛这破厂是赵坤名下，举起无信号手机狠狠砸在铁壁上，两人剑拔弩张。
shots.dialogue_zh: S1：放屁！这破厂是你名下的，分明你设局！
shots.end_frame_anchor_zh: 陆沉指着无信号手机怒火中烧，赵坤脸色阴沉剧烈咳嗽。

shots.title: 第1集 镜3：绝境喂水冰释前嫌
shots.summary_zh: 缺氧濒死之际，陆沉爬过去把最后两口救命水喂进高烧昏迷的赵坤嘴里，苦笑感叹金钱如粪土。
shots.dialogue_zh: S1：死在这铁棺材里，八十亿能烧给阎王吗？
shots.end_frame_anchor_zh: 陆沉扶着赵坤肩膀把空水瓶放下，赵坤睁眼震惊看着死对头热泪盈眶。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Gritty modern Chinese neo-noir thriller anime style, dark claustrophobic industrial lighting, emerald green emergency glow and harsh crimson shadows, continuing seamlessly from <Picture 1> inside the dim fading green-lit elevator hours later. Exhausted and parched, the 36-year-old Chinese man (S1) in the torn dark charcoal suit crawls beside the feverish, half-conscious 42-year-old man (S2) in the brown wool coat, gently tilting the last drops from a plastic water bottle into S2's cracked lips. overall_soundscape: Faint trickle of final drops of water, weak grateful swallow, quiet hollow sigh inside the silent dark steel box.

non_diegetic_music: Melancholic warm solo piano chords emerging softly out of the dark tension.

shots.title: 第1集 镜4：血手印签下百亿和解书
shots.summary_zh: 两人并肩背靠铁壁，在竞标书背面按下鲜红血手印立誓平分80亿，相视大笑。
shots.dialogue_zh: S2：好！按血手印平分，出去我请你喝茅台！
shots.end_frame_anchor_zh: 两只沾血大拇指重重按在白色协议纸上，两个昔日死对头虚弱大笑。

For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Gritty modern Chinese neo-noir thriller anime style, dark claustrophobic industrial lighting, emerald green emergency glow and harsh crimson shadows, continuing seamlessly from <Picture 1> inside the wrecked elevator. Leaning shoulder-to-shoulder against the rusty wall, the 36-year-old man (S1) and the 42-year-old man (S2) hold a crumpled white bidding contract paper between them. Pressing his bleeding thumb firmly onto the paper beside S1's red thumbprint, S2 laughs hoarsely with genuine emotion in his gruff, hoarse, commanding older Chinese male voice (S2): <d>[Chinese] 好！按血手印平分，出去我请你喝茅台！</d> Both battered rivals share an exhausted, brotherly grin as the bloody paper settles between them.

overall_soundscape: Crisp rustle of crumpled contract paper, weak relieved laughter echoing softly in the quiet metal shaft.

non_diegetic_music: Swelling heartfelt orchestral strings creating a moving sense of redemption and hope.

shots.title: 第2集 镜1：门外脚步声狂喜砸门
shots.summary_zh: 门外骤然响起急促脚步与铁器撞击声，陆沉狂喜爬向梯门拼命砸门大喊自己秘书带人来了。
shots.dialogue_zh: S1：有人！老赵快喊，是我秘书带人来救咱们！
shots.end_frame_anchor_zh: 陆沉双拳紧贴冰冷梯门狂喜回头，灰尘随着门外震动簌簌落下。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Gritty modern Chinese neo-noir thriller anime style, dark claustrophobic industrial lighting, emerald green emergency glow and harsh crimson shadows, continuing seamlessly from <Picture 1> inside the trapped freight elevator. Suddenly, heavy brisk boots and clanking steel echo right outside the closed elevator doors, shaking dust from the ceiling. Eyes lighting up with ecstatic relief, the 36-year-old Chinese man (S1) scrambles forward to pound desperately on the steel doors, shouting over his shoulder in his tense, gritty, raspy 35-year-old Chinese male baritone voice (S1): <d>[Chinese] 有人！老赵快喊，是我秘书带人来救咱们！</d> Behind him, S2's exhausted face beams with sudden wild hope.

overall_soundscape: Urgent heavy boots approaching outside the steel doors, metallic clank of tools, desperate pounding fists on hollow metal.

non_diegetic_music: Rising hopeful cinematic strings accelerating rapidly toward a breakthrough.

shots.title: 第2集 镜2：互争谁的救兵先到
shots.summary_zh: 赵坤靠在铁壁上得意大笑称是自家退伍保镖队先找到的，下一秒粗黑撬棍猛地插进门缝，笑容骤僵。
shots.dialogue_zh: S2：听这脚步声，是我保镖队先找到的！
shots.end_frame_anchor_zh: 一根黑色撬棍撕开电梯门缝迸出火花，门外却鸦雀无声，两人笑容瞬间凝固。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Gritty modern Chinese neo-noir thriller anime style, dark claustrophobic industrial lighting, emerald green emergency glow and harsh crimson shadows, continuing seamlessly from <Picture 1> inside the freight elevator. non_diegetic_music: Hopeful strings abruptly snap into a chilling, razor-sharp horror riser.

shots.title: 第2集 镜3：强光破门黑衣口罩男现身
shots.summary_zh: 铁门被强行撕开，强光手电刺入，戴黑口罩的刀疤男拎着红色汽油桶冷冷伫立门口，赵坤吓得魂飞魄散。
shots.dialogue_zh: S2：不对！他们不是我保镖，陆沉是你的人吗？
shots.end_frame_anchor_zh: 强光背影中刀疤男露出血腥冷眼，镜头定格在他手中晃动的红汽油桶。

non_diegetic_music: Bone-chilling horror string screech over an ominous sub-bass rumble.

shots.title: 第2集 镜4：认出自己雇来的杀手
shots.summary_zh: 刺眼白光照在陆沉惨白如纸的脸上，他认出刀疤男正是三天前自己花五百万雇来的杀手，彻底崩溃后退。
shots.dialogue_zh: S1：完了，那是我三天前花五百万雇来的杀手！
shots.end_frame_anchor_zh: 陆沉浑身剧烈颤抖瘫跌回铁壁，双眼瞳孔放大满是绝望与恐惧。

shots.title: 第3集 镜1：高举血手印和解书狂喊停手
shots.summary_zh: 陆沉手忙脚乱高举沾满血手印的和解协议挡在胸前，对着门外刀疤男歇斯底里狂喊取消单子。
shots.dialogue_zh: S1：停手！单子取消了，我们签了和解书！
shots.end_frame_anchor_zh: 陆沉拼命挥舞血手印纸张，刀疤男却一动不动冷漠俯视着他。

shots.title: 第3集 镜2：赵坤崩溃吐露双杀真相
shots.summary_zh: 一旁的赵坤面如死灰发出绝望惨笑，告诉陆沉把人骗进货梯的匿名短信也是他花五百万买的。
shots.dialogue_zh: S2：没用了，那条短信也是我花五百万买的！
shots.end_frame_anchor_zh: 赵坤绝望闭眼靠墙惨笑，陆沉猛地僵住缓缓转头死盯赵坤，彻底堕入冰窟。

shots.title: 第3集 镜3：亮出两笔五百万收全款
shots.summary_zh: 刀疤男居高临下举起手机亮出两笔五百万转账记录，冷笑宣告打包全收一千万，举桶泼洒汽油。
shots.dialogue_zh: S3：真巧，二位各付五百万，一千万我们全收！
shots.end_frame_anchor_zh: 透明汽油汹涌浇进货梯浸透血手印协议，刀疤男眼神冷酷毫无波动。

shots.title: 第3集 镜4：打火机坠落黑屏留白
shots.summary_zh: 铁门缓缓合拢只留窄缝，刀疤男在门缝外点燃银色打火机冷酷送别，火苗脱手坠向汽油瞬间定格。
shots.dialogue_zh: S3：收钱办事是行规，二位黄泉路正好做伴！
shots.end_frame_anchor_zh: 炽亮打火机火苗穿透窄缝向地面坠落，耀眼橙光照亮门缝外冷酷双眼定格。
